review.note: M53: the date on this relation is Wikidata’s, cited by item and property in sources — not a year read from memory, which is why it carries interval-cited rather than the seeding’s date flag.

note: Seven years stand between them: the colony ends 1815 and the Empire begins 1822-09-07. Wikidata holds a polity for those years — Q903779, the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves, 1815-12-16 to 1822-09-07 — and this atlas has no record of it, so the gap is named here and not closed. Written under the owner’s rule of 17 September, which allows a succession across a gap.
